column3: ...Well, I'm at fault too. I'll play it when we get home.
I'm saying you're too slow! There's still the fandisk!
Fandisk? Is it something like a sequel?
I get it. I'll play that too...
Wait, does this mean I'm weird?
But maybe I was a bit childish.
That girl probably wants to interact with people who have played similar games...
However, interacting with my little sister about little sister-related games...
*sigh*... It's tough being an elder brother...
